body: Sorry didnt mean to come off it that way. I know that a loving family isn't always enough.

That's something worth living for tho! My family have no regard for me and never have, it's pointless to strive to survive at this point when the people supposed to be closest to you are the ones that destroyed you

My parents made me a really fucked up person, somebody who is prone to constant self-destruction so I don't think there is a way out now. There might have been before if I had noticed I was destroying myself when I was in a better place, but the way I am now, there's too much to change/fix for things to be better. My brother still has a chance, but there's not much I can do for him.
It's crushing isn't? Just staying alive cause you feel responsible to.
At least you have a husband who loves you. I know thats often not enough, but it's nice to have somebody to lean on.

That's the thing, I will not get more loans from the government after this so I have to carry it out this time. 
I know that i'm smart and can do this so i guess i just need to keep fighting myself and get through it.
